files.description: Complete EHI export documentation PDF (12 pages). Contains overview of CCD export mechanism (single patient and bulk), screenshots of the export UI, and a data dictionary of 24 C-CDA sections with 82 data elements including XPATH paths, code system OIDs, and code system names.
Plain text extraction of the PDF via pdftotext. Table content is garbled due to multi-column layout issues; useful for text search but not reliable for structured data extraction.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that produces structured JSON from the PDF's data dictionary. Hand-curated from visual inspection of rendered PDF pages.

Machine-queryable JSON representation of the complete CCD data dictionary: 24 sections, 82 data elements, with template IDs, XPATH paths, code system OIDs, and code system names. Also includes export metadata (vendor, product, version, standard, export modes, selectable UI sections).
Extraction accounting: source file metadata, counts of sections/elements/code systems, extraction method notes, and known limitations.
Enrichment README with run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
